## Summary

I extended the existing domain-scoped ChatGPT/Z.AI manual-bridge audit system to real MODULE-scoped requests for compliance-tracker and projexa, reusing the schema/guard/versioning layer unchanged.

**Key findings:**
- compliance-tracker already has a real module registry (`compliance.module_registry`, a Postgres table seeded via ~30 `drizzle/*.sql` migrations) — 110 real modules, parsed mechanically from the actual `INSERT` statements.
- projexa has no equivalent — module boundaries derived mechanically from `src/app/api/<x>/` directory structure (79 real directories), per KNOWN_CONTEXT's sanctioned fallback.

**What shipped:**
- `scripts/module_gap_audit_lib.py` — new module-boundary resolver + file discovery (filename + content-grep on identifier variants) + ceiling-bounded chunk packing (~400 lines/~20KB, whole files never truncated)
- `--module`/`--repo` mode added to both `generate_chatgpt_audit_request.py` and `ingest_chatgpt_audit_response.py`, alongside the existing `--domain` mode (verified unchanged/still working)
- `ai-os/MODULE_GAP_AUDIT_MODULE_LIST_2026-07-25.yaml` — real, mechanically-computed module list for both repos
- 5 real request files generated for 5 real modules (3 compliance-tracker, 2 projexa) under `/opt/veridian/chatgpt-audit/_pending_requests/`
- `ai-os/MODULE_GAP_AUDIT_2026-07-25.yaml` — Owner procedure + honest scope statement
- `registries.module_gap_audit` registered in `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` and knowledge engine

**Honest scope:** 189 real modules exist across both repos, needing **1195** request files for full coverage. This task generated **5**; **1190 remain** — the Owner can generate any module's request on demand with `python3 scripts/generate_chatgpt_audit_request.py --module <name> --repo <compliance-tracker|projexa>`, or a future task can batch more of the backlog. All 4 SUCCESS_CRITERIA verified passing; work is committed and pushed (2 commits) to `worker/task-20260725-063204-module-scoped-zai-gap-audit`.
